The per-model price that OpenRouter publishes is not used because it corresponds to a reference provider that changes from one day to the next. Only the lab’s own prices are recorded as price changes.
exact.«Abiertos» con un repositorio público en: “Open” means a public repository on Hugging Face, linked by OpenRouter or with the same name in the lab’s organisation. Without a repository, Epoch’s classification if there is one; if not, “open · announced” when its OpenRouter description presents it as open-weight (it is not stated who writes it, so it is not attributed to the lab; it counts as open even though it cannot yet be downloaded), and otherwise “closed”, marked as inferred. The licence comes from the Hugging Face model card.
exact.La velocidad depende de quién sirve el m: Speed depends on who serves the model. The median measured by Artificial Analysis at the reference provider is shown, with the same configuration that gives its score; with reasoning at maximum, latency (time to first token) includes thinking time and can reach minutes. If AA does not have it, that of the fastest OpenRouter provider is used when its API publishes it.

En las vistas de modelos, la capacidad se mide con el Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v{v}, que AA calcula con sus propias pruebas y suele puntuar un modelo a los pocos días de salir. AA publica una cifra por configuración de razonamiento; se muestra la de mayor índice y se nombra. Junto a él figura el Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) de Epoch AI (CC BY 4.0), que combina muchos benchmarks con intervalo de confianza y es la base de las series históricas de «La carrera». Las dos escalas no son comparables entre sí. El emparejamiento con OpenRouter es por laboratorio y nombre normalizado.

In the model views, capability is measured with the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v{v}, which AA computes with its own tests and which usually scores a model a few days after release. AA publishes one figure per reasoning configuration; the one with the highest index is shown and named. Alongside it is Epoch AI’s Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) (CC BY 4.0), which combines many benchmarks with a confidence interval and is the basis of the historical series in “The AI Race”. The two scales are not comparable with each other. Matching with OpenRouter is by lab and normalised name.
